baslik: Describing Personality and Character, Clothing for Different
paragraflar: Personality & Character (Kişilik): «What is he/she like?» sorusuyla karakter sorulur; polite, helpful, patient, caring, clever, brilliant, organised, tidy, focused, independent, social olumlu; rude, lazy, shy diğer sıfatlardır.
Clothes, Body Parts & Accessories: Swimsuit, tights, trainers, necklace, bracelet, jewellery, wallet, purse, pocket, kit giysi/eşya; knee, ankle, back, leg, heart, stomach, skin vücut bölümleridir.
